title: REQ · Render constants are 480x270 and computeZoom always returns a whole number of at least 1
description: Context: config.ts has 640x360 and computeZoom returns NaN when dpr is NaN (Math.max(1, NaN)). Desired behavior: GAME_WIDTH=480, GAME_HEIGHT=270, computeZoom treats non-finite or non-positive dpr as 1 and floors to an integer of at least 1. Expected result: whole-number zoom for any window size and DPR. Why: pixel-perfect rendering.
acceptance_criteria: Given config.ts, when GAME_WIDTH and GAME_HEIGHT are read, then they are 480 and 270 and buildGameConfig width/height equal them.
Given (479,269,1) or dpr 0, NaN or negative, when computeZoom runs, then the result is 1.

preserve: pixelArt, roundPixels, antialias false, FIT, zoom parameter

technical_constraints: One native scene resolution of 480x270, whole-number scaling, nearest-neighbour.
